title: Higher-Order Testing for Conditional Distributional Treatment Effects with Hilbert-Valued Embeddings

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery repaired the fuzzy-mixture cell algebra, proved its legality/affinity spine, established the Fourier operator-null characterization, and derived a density-robust high-smoothness root-n construction plus a uniform-design rough lower bound. The attempt collapsed at the promised field-level centerpiece: no matched arbitrary bounded-density minimax frontier was proved, leaving the spectral iff and adaptive-grid test dependent open questions. A common-anchor U-statistic indexing error also remains, but fixing it would not restore the missing result or the field tier.
tldr: The all-tests SCoDiTE problem has two mathematically separate branches. When \(t>d/2\), a cell-local polynomial empirical higher-order estimator with rank \(M\asymp n^\gamma=o(n)\), a finite Neumann correction, and a common \(K_X\)-anchor has uniform mean-squared error \(O(n^{-1})\) over every bounded positive design density, without smoothness of \(f_X\) or of the feature map. Its deterministic class-oracle variance envelope gives uniform size and root-rate power; a regular constant-contrast path gives the matching lower bound when that path belongs to the class. For \(0<t\le d/2\), the separate collision and occupancy handle remains unchanged: the legal fuzzy construction proves the slower uniform-design lower radius \(n^{-2t/(2t+d)}\) for \(0<s\le1/2\), while the arbitrary-density match, spectral method classification, and adaptive grid remain open. Characteristicness of the outcome kernel does not turn the covariate-smoothed null into pointwise conditional homogeneity.
gap: Existing SCoDiTE theory is first order and pointwise in the law, direct spectral tests omit causal nuisances, and the empirical-HOIF theorem of Liu et al. treats scalar missing-at-random and doubly robust functionals with \(k=o(n)\). It therefore does not settle rough SCoDiTE scales with \(K_h>n\), although that non-subsumption alone is not evidence that occupancy worsens the rate.
fill: The candidate \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{occ}}\) records cell-pair availability and empirical-Gram inflation. The displayed \(P_\omega,Q_\omega\) tables separate a factorizing exact-null law from a nonfactorizing alternative with \(U_\omega=2u_\omega v_\omega b_Y/(1-u_\omega^2)\), and the legality lemma derives positivity, overlap, both Hölder memberships, nonzero \(\Psi\), covariance stability, the \(0<s\le1/2\) source bound, and mixture affinity from the construction. A collision-based higher-order score supplies the arbitrary-density attainment handle, and the resulting modulus feeds the spectral iff and adaptive-grid questions. In the high-smoothness branch the score yields the root-\(n\) upper bound under the declared assumptions, while equality uses a separately stated nondegenerate constant-contrast path only for the local lower-bound reduction.
